statement: The system shall support at least 500 concurrent applicant sessions.
The system shall be sized for a maximum of 100 concurrent applicant sessions.
The system shall keep an applicant's session active for 60 minutes without activity so that applicants can gather their documents.
The system shall end any applicant session after 15 minutes of inactivity.
The customer portal shall be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with no planned downtime.
The customer portal shall be taken offline every Sunday from 01:00 to 05:00 for planned maintenance.
The system shall retain rejected loan applications for 7 years.
The system shall delete rejected loan applications 12 months after the decision.
Branch staff shall be able to override the automated credit decision for any application.
Only the credit risk team shall be permitted to override an automated credit decision.
The system shall allow applicants to sign in using only their email address and a one-time link.
The system shall require multi-factor authentication for every applicant sign-in.
The system shall send the loan decision to the applicant by SMS.
The system shall not send loan decision details by SMS.
The eligibility check shall return a result within 2 seconds under normal load.
The eligibility check may take up to 10 seconds under normal load because it calls the credit bureau.
The system shall reject any personal loan application above 50,000 EUR.
The system shall accept personal loan applications of up to 75,000 EUR.
The system shall notify the applicant of the credit decision within one working day of a complete application.
Credit decisions shall be batched and notified to applicants once per week.
The system shall limit each uploaded document to a maximum size of 5 MB.
The system shall accept scanned supporting documents of up to 20 MB each.
Audit log entries shall never be modified or deleted.
Administrators shall be able to delete audit log entries older than 90 days to free storage.
The system shall display the application status page within 2 seconds during normal operation.
During month-end batch processing, the application status page may take up to 5 seconds to display.
The internal underwriting console shall be available during business hours, Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00.
The internal underwriting console may be taken offline on Saturdays for maintenance.
Staff sessions on the underwriting console shall expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.
The system shall move uploaded documents to archive storage 30 days after the application is decided.
The system shall send the loan decision to the applicant by email.
The application status page shall be displayed within 2 seconds during normal operation.
The system shall allow applicants to upload supporting documents in PDF format.
The system shall also accept JPEG and PNG images as supporting documents.
The system shall route any personal loan application above 25,000 EUR to manual review.
The system shall require multi-factor authentication for staff sign-in, except from the branch network where a smart card is used.
The system shall produce a monthly report of approved loans by branch.
The system shall offer the customer portal in English and Spanish.
The system shall record every change to an applicant's contact details in the audit log.
The system shall encrypt applicant documents at rest.
